title: Heuristics: AlphaPROBE ancestral DAG mining + retail investor horizon as PEAD modifier
rationale: Two additional findings from today's scan warranting heuristic extraction: (1) AlphaPROBE's Bayesian retriever with over-exploration penalty is a superior alternative to naive evolutionary mutation for factor generation; (2) Retail investor horizon composition (from StockTwits) predicts PEAD magnitude and duration — actionable for R31 position sizing.
content:
### AlphaPROBE DAG navigation prevents redundant factor generation
- LESSON: Model the factor pool as a DAG where each generated factor records its parent. Use a Bayesian retriever that penalizes nodes retrieved more than ~3 times: weight = quality × (1-ω)^n_retrievals. This prevents the evolutionary search from re-generating near-duplicates of high-IC factors, which is the main failure mode of naive mutation-based alpha mining.
- LESSON: AlphaPROBE achieves IC improvement vs AlphaAgent baseline (~5.84% vs ~3.5% on CSI300) specifically because ancestral lineage context prevents the generator from ignoring the 'what-already-worked-and-why' trail. Match this with FactorMiner's failure exclusion pool: success pool (DAG) + failure exclusion list = full coverage.
- WHEN: R33 factor mining implementation. Any LLM-driven alpha search where redundancy in the factor pool is a concern.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2602.11917 (AlphaPROBE, Feb 2026). GitHub: gta0804/AlphaPROBE.

### Retail investor horizon composition predicts PEAD magnitude (StockTwits signal)
- LESSON: Stocks favored by long-horizon retail investors (self-reported on StockTwits) show LARGER and MORE PERSISTENT PEAD after earnings beats, because long-horizon investors underreact (slower to incorporate news). Conversely, short-horizon retail dominance predicts overreaction and subsequent reversal.
- LESSON: The zero-cost strategy (long long-horizon stocks, short short-horizon stocks post-earnings) generates 0.43%/month alpha (annualized ~5.2%) — meaningful as a position-sizing signal, not strong enough alone as a standalone strategy.
- LESSON: Practical use: Before entering a PEAD trade, check if StockTwits commentary skews toward long-horizon language ('holding for 6-12 months', 'fundamental thesis') vs short-horizon ('quick trade', 'into earnings', 'scalp'). Long-horizon skew = upsize 1.25x. Short-horizon skew = hold baseline or skip if combined with weak quality score.
- WHEN: R31 text PEAD design; any future PEAD strategy that allows per-trade position sizing.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2512.00280 (Retail Investor Horizon and Earnings Announcements, Dec 2025)
